prompt:
Hey, you're the Integrator agent. I need you to add a Retrospective tab to the Dashboard agent cards in Mission Control.

Context: we built an /end-session command (in .claude/commands/end-session.md) that writes structured retrospectives to .claude/agent-hub/retrospectives/{sessionId}.json. But the Dashboard doesn't show them yet. When an agent closes and has a retrospective, I want to see it.

Your task:

1. Add a "Retrospective" tab next to Summary/Prompts/Timeline on Dashboard agent cards. It should show the retrospective data if it exists: accomplishments, decisions, unfinished work, insights.

2. The tab should only appear if a retrospective file exists for that session. If no retrospective, don't show the tab.

3. Make it visually clean. Accomplishments in green, unfinished in amber, insights in blue. Keep it scannable, not a wall of text.

4. Add an API endpoint GET /api/retrospectives/:sessionId that reads from the retrospectives directory.

Read CLAUDE.md at C:\Users\ephra\phredomade\CLAUDE.md first.

Key files:
- .claude/agent-hub/server.js (Dashboard HTML is embedded here, search for "Summary" and "Prompts" tabs. Also add the API endpoint)
- .claude/agent-hub/retrospectives/ (where /end-session writes JSON files)
- .claude/commands/end-session.md (understand what data gets written)

DON'T touch dispatch-page.html, campaigns-page.html, findings.json, hook.js, or prompt-hook.js.

The Dashboard HTML is embedded in server.js, not a separate file. Search for the tab rendering code.

Tell me your plan before building.
